projection.basis: Visually reviewed published Plan of San Marco: top-down architectural plan, parallel wall faces, explicit 0-10 metre scale, and keyed legend on the following page.

transform: translation only, equal x/y units; floor stacking is display-only
review: Page 6 plan and page 7 key were inspected together. All numbered features 1-29 and all mosaic keys A-R were transcribed; grouped legend entries retain distinct plan anchors. Structural mass is reconstructed only from the source's grey stipple density, while black outlines, stairs, fixtures and dome projections remain flat detail.
